Topology builder helpers for workspaces, objects, links, tiles, layout, and validation.

# Purpose
`fd_topob.h` declares the builder API for `fd_topo`, which is used to create and configure a topology for an application. It defines constants for link polling and reliability, then provides functions to create a topology, add workspaces, objects, links, and tiles, and connect tiles to input and output links. The file also declares helper functions for automatic CPU layout and for final validation and sizing of the topology before use.
